description: This file defines a custom React hook 'useTicTacToe' that manages the game logic for a Tic Tac Toe game, supporting both player-vs-player and player-vs-computer modes. It handles game state, move application, AI integration, and game outcomes.

methods.name: useTicTacToe( initialStarter = 'X', options = { mode: 'PVP', aiMark: 'O', aiLevel: AI_LEVELS.SIMPLE } )
methods.description: Main hook managing the state and logic of the Tic Tac Toe game, including AI moves and game status.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the game to initial state, optionally setting the starting player.

methods.name: setStarter
methods.description: Sets which player starts the game.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Handles a human player's move at the specified index, respecting game mode and turn order.

ctags.name: useTicTacToe
ctags.signature: ( initialStarter = 'X', options = { mode: 'PVP', aiMark: 'O', aiLevel: AI_LEVELS.SIMPLE } )
